confirmed_mechanism: CollectorBridge::child() measures the workspace every second while the export runs.
Recolector 7.4.2 replaces export-progress.json through <file>.tmp.<pid> plus rename, and Moodle removes temporary backup directories inside the same workspace.
usage() threw when a listed entry was removed before isFile/getSize, or when RecursiveDirectoryIterator opened a removed directory.

The exception leaves child() through finally, which sends SIGTERM to the bridge's own process group; the bridge's handler marks it cancelled and run() returns 143 with a cancelled event, although nobody requested cancellation.

reproduction.runtime: php:8.3-cli on Linux 6.6 (WSL2), uid 33, same churn pattern as collector_atomic_json and Moodle temporary directories

not_explained_by_this_defect.browser_case: Run 39298199232 attempt 1: operation was TERMINATED/SUCCEEDED (exit 0) while the collection step was still RUNNING. The export finished before the 20 s poll observed CONNECTED; the bridge was not terminated.
